comment: The first lane's mode switch is declared but never given a widget (it has no position in the census), because cascade has no meaning there: the first lane has no lane above it to be fed from and falls back to parallel. The clock divider multiplies with the buffer length rather than replacing it, so a lane at four steps divided by three comes out twelve input clocks behind.
